categories.name: Set Alarm/Reminder

categories.name: Call/Message Contact
categories.definition: User wants to call or message a specific contact.

categories.name: Weather Inquiry
categories.definition: User wants to know the weather forecast for a specific location or time.

categories.name: Music Playback
categories.definition: User wants to play music or a specific song/artist.

categories.name: Recipe Inquiry
categories.definition: User wants to find a recipe or cooking instructions for a specific dish.

categories.name: News Inquiry
categories.definition: User wants to know the latest news or updates on a specific topic.

categories.name: Timer/Stopwatch Control
categories.definition: User wants to start, stop, or modify a timer or stopwatch.

categories.name: Cancel/Delete Reminder
categories.definition: User wants to cancel or delete a previously set reminder or alarm.
